text:
Priya S (SE): kicking off FinCo POC thread — customer requires BYO KMS/HSM for envelope encryption of model artifacts + runtime attestation. They want rotation window <=24h, offline key ceremony ok. Also customer asked for pricing delta for HSM-backed BYOK vs standard CMK.
Liam K (AE): customer question — do we bill for egress to their HSM? they asked if HSM proxy traffic counts as tokens/requests or as a separate ops line item.
Priya S (SE): short answer: HSM proxy calls (e.g., wrap/unwrap) are billed as per-key-ops in the SOW when BYOK is enabled. For Dedicated we usually add an HSM add-on monthly fee + per-op rate. I'll pull numbers.
Jules R (Security): sec questionnaire item: they want diagram and proof of key separation, attestation report (certificate) and KMS rotation proof. Can we provide an HSM attestation doc + network diagram showing key material never leaves customer HSM?
Tom H (SRE): attestation: yes we can provide vendor-signed attestation (e.g., CloudHSM attestation) and our integration notes. For network, customer must whitelist egress CIDRs and allow TLS mutual auth to our key-proxy endpoint. Add note: latency expectation for wrap/unwrap ~5-20ms depending on region.
Amanda (Deal Ops): pricing ask: customer wants two options in quote — 1) BYOK with hosted key-proxy (we manage proxy, HSM in customer VPC) and 2) full on-prem HSM (private deployment). Need clear SOW bullets re: support hours, runbook, and failure mode billing.
Liam K (AE): acceptance criteria: 1) POC demonstrates end-to-end encryption with customer key, 2) rotation performed without request drops, 3) perf within SLA (95th <= 150ms end-to-end for gen requests), 4) audit logs available to customer for key ops. Can we confirm we can surface key-op events to their SIEM?
Priya S (SE): yes — we can stream key operation audit logs to their Cloudwatch/Datadog/Splunk endpoint (customer supplies endpoint/credentials). We'll include sample log schema.
Jules R (Security): SQ item: they asked about key escrow/dual custody. They insist on two-custodian dry-run. Can Redwood support a split-key workflow or must customer handle split custody entirely in their HSM?
Tom H (SRE): split custody is typically handled in-customer HSM. We can integrate if customer exposes unwrap endpoints. For multi-custodian ceremonies customer will run the ceremony and provide resulting KEK to our proxy. We'll document the dry-run steps in the runbook.
Priya S (SE): quick config snippet (for docs):
```
redwoodctl kms bind --mode byo --key-id arn:cloudhsm:us-west-2:customer:hk-12345 \
  --proxy-endpoint https://key-proxy.finco.example --mtls-cert /path/to/cert.pem
```
Liam K (AE): security/legal question — indemnity for lost keys? They pressed for clause on customer-managed-keys liability. Legal will push back on unlimited liability.
Amanda (Deal Ops): note for quote: include optional professional services line for ceremony support (flat 8-16h), and pen-test coordination (we can support network tests but customer must schedule HSM vendor).
Jules R (Security): last ask — include FIPS/FIPS140-2/3 status of HSM, and SOC2 artifact availability. Also they want a pointer to our KMS rotation logs retention policy (we usually keep 90 days by default, can extend).
Priya S (SE): I'll attach the attestation doc, sample runbook, log schema, and a draft SOW pricing options. Back after I sync with finance on per-op rates. :thumbsup:
redwood-deploy-bot: file uploaded: finco-poc/attestation.pdf
Amanda (Deal Ops): thanks — I'll queue the two-variant quote and push the PS line into the SOW. Closing the loop in next 24h. :white_check_mark:
